scene.name: s1_2x4_lean4.000_ax-Y
scene.reference_meaning: Stage 0 has no floor. The generator +Z axis is the angle reference. The cloud is not rotated.
scene.description: Phase 1 S1 synthetic dressed stud. Lean 4.000 deg about -Y. Long axis is +Z before the right-hand rotation. Generator gravity is +Z. No floor. The cloud is not rotated.

knob_notes.primitives: QRANSAC-SD shapes are PLANE, SPHERE, CYLINDER, CONE, and TORUS. There is no cuboid primitive. This run enables PLANE. CYLINDER stays off when it is not listed: a dressed 2x4 is not a cylinder, and a cylinder inlier set was an extra detection on the untuned pass.
knob_notes.epsilon_absolute_m: 0.006 m max distance from a point to the primitive. Generator noise is 1 mm and the surface spacing is 5 mm. The value stays under half of the 38 mm dressed thickness so the opposite face is not swallowed into the same plane.
knob_notes.bitmap_epsilon_absolute_m: 0.012 m in-plane bitmap cell (Schnabel bitmap epsilon). Larger than the 5 mm spacing so one face stays one primitive instead of splitting into shards.
knob_notes.support_points: 800 minimum inliers. At 5 mm spacing a narrow 2x4 face is about 3700 points and an end cap is about 135. A threshold in the hundreds keeps the long faces and drops end-grain crumbs.
knob_notes.max_normal_dev_deg: 25.0 degrees. Points whose normals leave the primitive by more than this are not inliers. Stud faces are planar.
knob_notes.probability: 0.01 is the probability that a better candidate was overlooked. Lower is a longer search. 0.01 is the plugin's usual setting.
knob_notes.merge: Planes that match a dressed 2x4 face (long face ~2.44 m by 38 or 89 mm, or an end cap with a normal near +Z) are grouped. Adjacent face centers within 120 mm are one stud. Coplanar shards of one face are one face. The group is one point set and one minimal OBB. If several groups exist, the best section, length, and Z-up score is kept. This pass keeps one box. It is not a multi-stud segmenter.

attempt.gpl: Separate process. GPL sources were not copied into this repository.

implementation_short: CloudCompare 2.14.beta (Aug 29 2026) RANSAC-SD, planes merged into one dressed-2x4 OBB. epsilon 0.006 m, support 800, primitives PLANE.

detection.note: RANSAC-SD plane faces that match a dressed 2x4 are merged into one stud box. One scene keeps the best box by section, length, and a long axis near +Z. Counts are this synthetic stud, not a field accuracy.

geometry.note: Section and length are the minimal OBB of the merged stud points versus the dressed 2x4. The plugin has no cuboid. The box is the union of accepted face planes.

angle.band_meaning: Percent of matched studs whose |measured - synthetic truth| is within the working tolerance.
angle.note: Truth is the generator lean against +Z. Not a SKIL reading. The long axis is the longest side of the merged minimal OBB.

paint.production_rule: epsilon unlocked, so every stud is yellow
paint.hypothetical_placeholder_note: 0.05 deg is a round illustration of the color rule. It is not a measured device band.
paint.note: Do not read hypothetical colors as a pass/fail call.

cost.license_note: CloudCompare was executed as a separate process. Its sources were not vendored or linked.
failure_modes: QRANSAC-SD has no cuboid. A missed face leaves the section short.
The merge keeps one box. A second stud in the same cloud would be dropped.
A cylinder on a 2x4 is the wrong section and is not enabled in the tuned command.
GPL-3.0 blocks shipping a closed app linked to CloudCompare. This run does not link it.
cost.note: Runtime includes the CloudCompare process on this one stud. It is not a field budget.

notes: Synthetic stage 0 only. Not a field measurement. Device epsilon is unlocked, so production paint is yellow.
